name: Móvil: el tema oscuro cambia y persiste tras recargar la página
description: El toggle de tema (aria-label 'Alternar tema oscuro/claro') alterna el fondo entre claro y oscuro y la elección persiste al recargar la página (guardada en localStorage), sin romper el layout.

planSteps.description: Tap the theme toggle button (aria-label 'Alternar tema oscuro/claro')
The page background switches to the dark theme (the dark class is applied) and content remains readable
After the reload the dark theme is still applied, showing the choice was persisted (localStorage 'theme' = dark)
Tap the theme toggle button again to switch back to light
The page switches back to the light theme and the page still renders correctly with no layout break
